reviews.text: We've already taken many courses there with our dogs and they've all been good.

Wonderful dog school Ilo in Oulunkylä! Really knowledgeable trainers and a welcoming feeling right from the start. Everything works great. A shop where you can buy supplies, treats and food for dogs. I recommend ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We had an excellent puppy course. Skilled and encouraging instructor.
